column3: The sky at one moment: a thin horizon line with the Sun, a crescent Moon and three small planet dots above it, and one dotted vertical line marking the moment
The twelve houses together: a diamond chart outlined in twelve cells with one cell lit
The parts of a chart: a diamond chart with three small tags pointing to its corner, its centre and its edge
Where to start: a trail of three stepping stones leading to a small door with a lamp above it
